# Loading in Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Loading in Data
```{r}
setwd('/Users/lawrencehuynh/PSTAT 197A/PSTAT174-Module0-Class-Survey-Team7')

# loading in data
(background <- 
  read.csv('data/background-clean.csv'))

(interest <- 
  read.csv('data/interest-clean.csv'))

# list of mandatory courses
mandatory <- c("PSTAT 120", "CS 9", "PSTAT 122", "PSTAT 126", "CS 16")

# joint data from Phillip 
joint <- background %>%
  inner_join(interest, by = "response_id") %>%
  
  # separates the string containing the list of courses into each course code
  # counts number of courses taken that were not in our list of mandatory courses
  mutate(non_mandatory = sum(!(strsplit(courses, 
                                split = ", ")[[1]] %in% mandatory)), 
                                .by = "courses") %>%
  
  # separates the string containing the list of areas of interest by the commas
  # counts the number of areas of interest
  # some areas of interest have ", generally" attached to the end
  # accidentally counts generally as an area since it comes after comma
  # counts the number of "generally" and subtracts from the original count
  mutate(num_areas = length(
    strsplit(areas[[1]], split = ", ")[[1]]) - 
      sum(strsplit(areas[[1]], split = ", ")[[1]] == "generally"), 
    .by = areas)

# getting count of specific courses
course_count <- joint %>%
  # separating courses by comma 
  separate_rows(courses, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  
  # creating clean course column 
  mutate(courses = trimws(courses)) %>%
  
  # drop empty string 
  filter(courses != "") %>%
  
  # counting amount of time a course appears 
  count(courses, name = "n") 

# splitting count by mandatory and non-mandatory courses
(mandatory_course_count <- course_count %>%
  filter(courses %in% mandatory)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

(non_mandatory_course_count <- course_count %>%
  filter(!courses %in% mandatory)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))


```

# EDA

```{r}
# bar plot of Number of Areas of interest
ggplot(joint, aes(x = num_areas)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#003660", col = "#FEBC11") +
  labs(x = "Number of Areas of Interest", y = "Number of People Interested in X Areas") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 13, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 2))

# pie chart of non-mandatory classes 
ggplot(non_mandatory_course_count, aes(x= "", y = n, fill = reorder(courses, -n))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Pie Chart of Non-Mandatory Classes", fill = "Courses (Descending Order)") +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.3, label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y")+
  theme_void()
```
